title: Former NFL QB Craig Morton dies at 83

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Former NFL QB Craig Morton dies at 83
sources.description: Former NFL quarterback Craig Morton, who led the Broncos to their first Super Bowl appearance, died on May 9 at his home in Mill Valley, California, the Broncos announced Monday.
